Lead Developer

Ryan Bigg

me@ryanbigg.com · linkedin.com/in/ryanbigg · github.com/radar · ryanbigg.com

Individual contributor for two decades. Comfortable working from junior developers up to the CEO. Known for quickly nailing down problems, working across varied stacks, and helping people learn.

I've worked most recently as a full-stack tech lead at a payment processing company. I was sought after for my in-depth Ruby on Rails knowledge, as well as my tenacity to dive into difficult problems. I enjoy making great (fast!) software, and delighting users. I use AI tools like Claude Code deliberately, keeping human review and existing team guardrails in place rather than letting them run unchecked.

I would be happy to work as either a senior individual contributor, or as a manager of developers. I have previously worked in other domains such as customer engagement surveys (Culture Amp), internet-of-things (LIFX), and developer training (Coder Academy). I have a long history of writing documentation and technical books.

Skills: AI / Claude Code, React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, Elixir, Go, Redis, Elasticsearch, design systems & technical leadership.
